messages:
alex: quick sync 10 - thinking about adding a lightweight routing/quota transport header so routing decisions and quota attribution can be done server-side. want feedback on shape + SDK changes.
marta: do you mean a brand new header or reusing routehint?
alex: new header to avoid overloading routehint. proposal name: X-Redwood-Route-Meta with flat k=v; pairs separated by semicolons. example: X-Redwood-Route-Meta: quota=mobile_high;policy=latency_pref
samir: new header sounds cleaner. parseability is important for proxies and the routing-service. prefer simple flat map, no nested structures.
rachel: flagged: SDK break risk. plan for non-breaking defaults + explicit opt-in please. also need encoding rules for special chars.
liam: console implications: we'd like to surface the "quota bucket" in the route analytics tile and allow filtering by it. metrics API needs a group_by=quota_key option.
marta: telemetry events: rw.route_meta.set and rw.route_meta.missing. emit counts and sample headers (redacted) for debugging. record if header truncated by proxy.
samir: SDK sketch: python: add optional route_meta: Dict[str,str] to Client.generate; ts: routeMeta?: Record<string,string> on options; go: functional opt WithRouteMeta(map[string]string). These are additive features (minor semver).
alex: encoding rules: only ascii k and v, url-encode values, no spaces. max header length 512 bytes. if exceeds, server logs and increments rw.route_meta.truncated.
rachel: tests: unit tests for encoding, integration test via a small env proxy that enforces max header size, console E2E to ensure mapping shows up in quota tile.
liam: dashboard side: add toggle to aggregate by quota_key vs route_name. backend change: metrics endpoint accept group_by=quota_key and aggregation column for cost attribution.
marta: rollout plan: 1) opt-in beta via env var RW_ROUTE_META_OPTIN for SDKs and clients; 2) collect rw.route_meta.* telemetry for 2w; 3) enable server mapping for opt-in orgs; 4) after validation, flip default for self-serve accounts; enterprise requires explicit opt-in.
samir: implementation notes: SDKs must not attach header by default. env opt-in should allow orgs to globally enable until caller-side param available. name in SDKs: route_meta. transport header: X-Redwood-Route-Meta. versioning: if we need breaking changes, create X-Redwood-Route-Meta-V2.
rachel: security: need a short security review for header parsing and size caps; also ensure no PII ends up in header. add scrub rules in server.
alex: error handling: server should treat malformed header as absent (fall back to legacy routing) and emit rw.route_meta.invalid. do not reject requests.
marta: ops: add alert if >1% requests for an org have route_meta.invalid or truncated.
samir: plan to open SDK PRs behind feature flag. target: minor releases in 10 business days, gated by RFC doc.
alex: I'll author RFC with examples, encoding table, migration timeline. owners: @samir SDKs, @liam console, @marta telemetry/ops, @rachel security.
dev-bot: CI: routing-service tests queued (job 4821).
alex: thanks all. leaving thread open for any edge cases or additional failover rules.
